integrity: The analytical theorem is accompanied by an independent deterministic finite-volume and exact-single-cusp comparison; finite computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive thermal diffusion, Poisson symmetric flips, and exactly equal linear tails beyond a compact set; no uniform rate at the critical active speed. Physical entropy depends on orientation time-reversal convention. General single-cusp formulas preexist; independent priority and validation are unperformed.
title: Universal rare-tumbling dissipation threshold in linear-tailed active traps
